body:
Closing — the framework already has **one consistent, deterministic** value-resolution contract for flow node values; the confusion in the repro was wrong-syntax guessing (`{{double-brace}}`, `$source.x`), not inconsistent behavior. The single source of truth is the `interpolate()` engine ([template.ts](packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts)).

## The contract (authoritative)
A node value (e.g. `create_record` / `update_record` `fields`) is a **string template**. `{…}` tokens are resolved; everything else is a **literal**.

| Token | Resolves to |
|---|---|
| `{var}` | the flow variable `var` (any type; preserves type when the whole value is a single token) |
| `{var.path.seg}` | dotted path walk on the resolved value (objects) |
| `{var.0}` / `{rec.items.2}` | **array index** (numeric segment) — added in #1872 |
| `{record.id}` | a record variable's field (e.g. a `create_record` `outputVariable` now holds the record — #1873) |
| `{$User.Id}` / `{$User.Email}` | current user |
| `{NOW()}` / `{TODAY()}` / `{TODAY() + 90}` | timestamp / date (+ N days) |
| `{a + b}`, `{x ? y : z}` | arithmetic / mixed expression over variables (safe charset) |
| anything without `{…}` | **literal string** |

So `body: '{{ai_suggested_reply}}'` should be `'{ai_suggested_reply}'`; `ticket: '$source.id'` should be `'{source.id}'` (with `source` bound as a variable).

## On the proposed M1 (typed `{ literal } / { expr } / { ref }`)
Declined as a **breaking** redesign of every existing flow + template. The existing single-syntax contract is sufficient once documented; this issue (and #1873/#1872) have removed the actual sharp edges.

## Remaining
The "all templates write flows consistently" acceptance item is an `objectstack-ai/templates` task (cross-repo) — please track it there. The framework-side semantics are consistent and documented (template.ts header + this contract). If a specific value form still resolves surprisingly, file a focused bug.
